_comment: Rule 1 name clearance, one entry per catalogue game. Raised by issue #2515: data/catalog.yaml records the reference app's name for every game and nothing compared it to ours, so 89 of 107 shipped names were identical to the reference and no decision was written down anywhere. This file is that decision, per game, and scripts/check-game-names.mjs enforces that it stays complete and honest.

_status.generic: Name is the ordinary name of a public-domain game or a plain description of the activity. Identical to the reference name is fine; nobody owns it.
_status.renamed: We chose a name that differs from the reference. Must actually differ, and the guard checks that.
_status.pending: A coined name still identical to the reference app's. This is real exposure and it is NOT cleared. Renaming is a product decision (it moves the slug and breaks existing links), so it is the owner's call and is tracked by #2515 rather than done here.
_status.original: No reference game exists — this one was not reimplemented from anything, so there is no name to have copied. Distinct from 'renamed', which records a decision taken; here there was never anything to decide.
